steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Mathematical modelling: Using algebra to represent real-life situations. This involves: Defining variables Writing expressions or equations Solving to find unknown values Interpreting solutions in context

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: I think of a number, double it, then subtract 5. The result is 17. Find the number. | A rectangle has sides x and 2x - 1. The perimeter is 32 cm. Find x. | Tickets cost £12 for adults and £8 for children. A group of 10 people pays £96. How many adults?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A school trip costs £200 per adult and £120 per child. The total cost for a group is £2800. There are 20 people in total. (a) Write two equations.
